planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Navigate to /appointment. Verify the appointment booking page loads with service selection options.
Select a service type like 'Consultation' or 'Fitting'. Verify it becomes highlighted or selected.
Click Next and select an available date on the calendar. Then select an available time slot.
Enter name, email, phone number in the contact details step. Verify all fields accept input.

planSteps.step: Navigate to alterations page via footer
planSteps.description: Scroll to the footer of the site and click the Alterations link. Verify the alterations info page loads with a call-to-action to contact.
Navigate to a product that has rental pricing (productType 'rent' or 'both'). Verify the rental option and price are displayed.
Navigate to /quiz. Answer all 4 questions (occasion, style, color, budget). Verify a style recommendation result appears.
Navigate to /wedding-checklist. Verify the 6-step checklist is displayed with progress tracking.
Navigate to /faq. Verify FAQ categories and accordion items are visible. Try clicking an FAQ item to expand it.
